M6.G4_cup_G4_in_internal_dimension6: zero by form degree; does not imply all 11D CS terms vanish.
M6.flux_integrality: [G4/(2pi)] is integral, no p1/4 shift. Three free integer flux components Nxy,Nxt,Nyt.

Witten_shift_formula: [G4/(2pi)]-lambda/2 integral, lambda=p1/2; both families have p1=0 so no half-integral gravity shift on the internal six-manifold.

circle6_example_euler_6_6.Witten_Cfield_quantization: p1/4 zero. Flux characteristic class can include a Z_g torsion sector invisible to real G4 curvature.
circle6_example_euler_6_6.stable_tangent_proof: Vertical tangent of oriented circle bundle trivial; TY stably pi*T(S2xS2)+R. Both base S2 factors have w2 and p1 zero, so pullbacks vanish.

naive_wrapped_D5.precise_obstruction: The D5 worldvolume Y5xR is spin, so W3=0, while the nonzero integral NS H3=k*z restricts nontrivially; Freed-Witten anomaly absent additional brane endpoints or compensating mechanisms.
naive_wrapped_D5.scope: Only this proposed naive wrapped D5. Not a classification of all D-brane charges or proof that string compactification is impossible.

flat_Cfield_exact_sequence: For degree-four differential cohomology, flat fields are H^3(M,R/Z). They contain U(1)^{b3} times Tor H^4(M,Z) (as abstract compact abelian groups).
not_a_Page_charge_dictionary: Topological C-field quantization, spin and a particular Freed-Witten consistency condition, NOT an M/IIB duality of all physical charges, brane endpoints, or full 11D equation.
